sections.markdown:
## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Section Three Testing

FACT_ID: sec03-R01 | anchor: A01
Three tests gate three things: vision screens eyesight, knowledge probes rules, and the drive test grades real skill [A01].
Why it matters: group test-types; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec03-F01, sec03-F05, sec03-F11 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec03-R02 | anchor: A01
The knowledge test bundles format, attempts, and retakes: multiple choice questions, three tries before reapplying, and a seven-day minor wait excluding the failure day [A01].
Why it matters: group knowledge-test; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec03-F05, sec03-F06, sec03-F07 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec03-R03 | anchor: A01
eLearning is the renewal-only no-fail self-paced course with quizzes per module, never a substitute for the original-license knowledge test [A01].
Why it matters: group knowledge-test; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec03-F05, sec03-F08 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec03-R04 | anchor: A02
Test day needs four bring-categories: papers for you, a licensed adult beside you, a legal car beneath you, and rental terms that permit testing [A02].
Why it matters: group test-day; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec03-F14, sec03-F15, sec03-F16, sec03-F17 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec03-R05 | anchor: A02
The car's numbers cluster: at least two mirrors with one left, thirty-second-inch tread minimum, one inch of pedal clearance, and a horn heard at two hundred feet [A02].
Why it matters: group vehicle-check; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec03-F20, sec03-F22, sec03-F23, sec03-F24 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec03-R06 | anchor: A02
The demo trio is hands, arms, and gear: set and release the parking brake, flash all three arm signals, and prove wipers plus belts [A02].
Why it matters: group vehicle-check; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec03-F25, sec03-F26, sec03-F27 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec03-R07 | anchor: A03
Only the examiner rides along, interpreters stop at the pre-drive inspection, and every recorder stays off or blocked [A03].
Why it matters: group test-conduct; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec03-F29, sec03-F30, sec03-F31 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec03-R08 | anchor: A03
Assistance tech that drives for you is banned, while safety tech that only shows you more is allowed yet never replaces your own eyes [A03].
Why it matters: group test-conduct; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec03-F32, sec03-F33 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0013]
